add.entry: PlayerBackpackManager.GiveAmmoToPlayer(SNet_Player, float standardRel, float specialRel, float classRel)
decoded: 0x175468C call SNetStructs.pPlayer::SetPlayer  ; the pAmmoGive the body builds carries the target player
0x1754698/0x17546A8/0x17546B6 movss [rsp+50h]/[rsp+54h]/[rsp+58h]  ; the three relative amounts land at pAmmoGive +0x10/+0x14/+0x18
add.gates: the body itself tests nothing: the manager's own null checks are its only early exits, so the caller is the authority gate (this adapter's host gate)
add.kind: host-authoritative action: its receive half applies the change through PlayerAmmoStorage.PickupAmmo, so a client cannot be written directly

addCallSite.callers: the only literal caller of GiveAmmoToPlayer in the image is PlayerAgent::GiveAmmoRel (--callers 0x1754630)
addCallSite.note: ResourcePackFirstPerson.ApplyPack (0x13BF2D0) is the resource pack's own apply body; it reaches the local backpack's storage write directly (see consume) and reaches the gift for a player it does not own the storage of

applyPath.receive: PlayerBackpackManager.ReceiveAmmoGive(pAmmoGive) 0x17589D0 calls 0x1749830 PlayerAmmoStorage::PickupAmmo three times (0x1758C62, 0x1758C89, 0x1758CB0), each with movd xmm2,[rbp+178h]; cvtdq2ps; mulss xmm2,xmm1 — xmm1 is the packet's own relative amount and the int is the pool capacity, so the relative value becomes an absolute pool delta
applyPath.storage: PlayerAmmoStorage.PickupAmmo indexes m_ammoStorage[(int)ammoType] and calls InventorySlotAmmo::AddAmmo(ammoAmount)
applyPath.readback: PlayerAmmoStorage.GetBulletsInPack(AmmoType) is the pool's own answer; PlayerBackpackManager.GetBulletsInPack(type, player) is the same read keyed by player

decoded: 0x174AE15 cmp esi,[rbx+18h] / jae  ; an ammo type outside the storage's own table is refused by the body
0x174AE71 addss xmm6,xmm7 / 0x174AE82 call Mathf::Clamp  ; clamp(pack + delta, 0, AmmoMaxCap)
consume.clamping: both ends: Mathf::Clamp(value, 0, AmmoMaxCap) — which is why a deduction goes through this body and not through the gift
consume.whyNotTheGift: InventorySlotAmmo.AddAmmo (0x12F7D70) is Min(AmmoInPack + amount, AmmoMaxCap) with no lower clamp (0x12F7DD0 addss xmm6,xmm7; 0x12F7DDE call Mathf::Min; 0x12F7DE7 movss [rbx+18h],xmm0), so a negative gift amount could drive a pool below zero; the gift carries no amount field for the ResourcePackRel, None and CurrentConsumable pools either

ammo_add.poolSelection: the `ammo_type` structural parameter, whose six members and the native enum's six members share one order; only Standard, Special and Class have a pAmmoGive field, so the other three are refused with `ammo-pool-has-no-gift`
ammo_add.amount: the row's `amount` is a round count; it is converted against the pool's own cap read immediately before the call (GetAmmoMaxCap) and the bullets that landed are the difference the same pool reports afterwards (GetBulletsInPack). The result's `amount` is that readback
ammo_add.overflowPolicy: `clamp` is the native behaviour; `reject` is implemented as a pre-read refusal (`ammo-pool-overflow`) with nothing written; `discard` is refused by name (`ammo-overflow-discard-unsupported`) because the native body clamps and a discard that clamped would be a different action

refusedByPort.cap: ammo-cap-unsupported — every pool already has the game's own cap
refusedByPort.provenance: ammo-provenance-unsupported — pAmmoGive carries no source field

ammo_consume.pool: any of the six native pools, because UpdateBulletsInPack indexes the storage's own table
ammo_consume.ownership: the pool must be this machine's own player's or a bot's (`SNet_Player.IsLocal || IsBot`): a remote client's ammunition is its own state, synced to the host through PlayerAmmoStorage.NeedsSync / PlayerBackpackManager.SendLocalAmmoData (0x175B280) and ReceiveAmmoSync (0x1758EA0), so a write to the host's mirrored copy would be overwritten by its owner; it is refused with `ammo-pool-not-owned-here`
ammo_consume.failurePolicy: `reject` refuses when the pool holds less than the request (`ammo-pool-insufficient`); `partial` spends what the pool holds and reports the number

refusedByPort.transaction: ammo-transaction-unsupported — the storage write is one clamped field write and has nowhere to put a transaction handle

testCoverage.outputsAreSynthetic: the doubles record what each entry point was asked and apply what the game's own bodies apply; nothing here is game-verified

unverified: no game process ran: whether SNet_AuthorativeAction<pAmmoGive>::Ask executes on the host and replicates to the clients is inferred from its body and from the packet/validation/receive chain, not observed
whether a remote client's mirrored pool on the host is really overwritten by its owner's next sync was not observed in game; the consume row refuses that case rather than relying on it

the relative-to-absolute conversion assumes the pool capacity the receive body multiplies by is the same GetAmmoMaxCap answers (the decode reads an int at PlayerAgent+0x178); the row reports the readback instead of the request, so a wrong assumption shows up as a smaller landed amount, never as a claimed write

the ResourcePackRel, None and CurrentConsumable pools were not observed being spent in game; the consume row accepts them because UpdateBulletsInPack indexes the storage's own table, and the add row refuses them because pAmmoGive has no field for them
